theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_pointwise_cutoff_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (F : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable F ν → (∀ x, x ∉ U → F x = 0) → ∀ (t : ℝ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → Measurable (χ h)) → (∀ h s : ℝ, 0 < h → |χ h s| ≤ 1) → (∀ h s : ℝ, 0 < h → s ≤ t - h → χ h s = 1) → (∀ h s : ℝ, 0 < h → t ≤ s → χ h s = 0) → Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ∫ x, χ h (f x) * F x ∂ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ x in {x | x ∈ U ∧ f x < t}, F x ∂ν))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
